events.title: Ukrainian drone strike on Rosneft Tuapse refinery
events.capacity_units_note: Operator publishes capacity in tonnes, not barrels/day: Rosneft states design capacity '12 million tons/year for oil' for unit ELOU-AVT-12. No operator figure in b/d exists. Secondary b/d figures are conversions of that same 12 Mt/y and disagree (see conflicts), so kbd is left unknown rather than resolved by choosing a barrels-per-tonne factor, which would be this session's assumption and not a source's.

days_to_partial_restore.source_publisher: Kyiv Independent, reporting Reuters citing two industry sources
days_to_partial_restore.derivation: strike 2024-01-25 to first reported resumption 2024-05-01 = 97 days. Both dates are sourced; the day count is arithmetic on them, not an estimate. PARTIAL, not full: the source reports 20,000 tonnes processed on 1 May against a 12 Mt/y nameplate (~32,900 t/day).

claims.note: presented as the b/d equivalent of 12 Mt/y

conflicts.resolution: declined; left unknown. Both are conversions of the operator's 12 Mt/y and differ only in the assumed barrels-per-tonne factor.

events.title: Ukraine escalates drone strikes on Russian refineries
events.capacity_units_note: OUT OF SCOPE BY CONSTRUCTION. This corpus row is an aggregate — 'Ukraine escalates drone strikes on Russian refineries' — not a strike on one identified asset. EXPOSURE_REGISTRATION.md §2 requires a single `asset_name` and one `capacity_nameplate_kbd`; an aggregate has neither. Decomposing it into its constituent strikes would create events the corpus does not contain, which is out of this block's authority.
